mapper.select: SELECT p.productId, p.categoryId, p.prodName, p.price, p.discRate, p.thumbnail, p.brand FROM product p WHERE p.productId = #{productId}

WITH LatestStock AS ( SELECT optionId, changedStock, changeDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY optionId ORDER BY changeDate DESC, logId DESC) AS RN FROM stockLog ) SELECT po.productId, po.optionId, po.prodSize, po.color, po.addPrice, NVL(ls.changedStock, 0) AS changedStock FROM productOption po LEFT JOIN LatestStock ls ON po.optionId = ls.optionId AND ls.RN = 1 WHERE po.productId = #{productId}
SELECT p.productId, pi.imageId, pi.files, pi.sortOrder FROM product p INNER JOIN productImage pi ON p.productId = pi.productId WHERE p.productId = #{productId}
SELECT count(*) FROM product p INNER JOIN wishlist w ON p.productId = w.productId WHERE p.productId = #{productId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO wishlist (wishlistId, createdAt, memberId, productId) VALUES(wishlistSeq_NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{memberId}, #{productId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlist WHERE memberId = #{memberId} AND productId = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT orderItemId, productId, rating, contents, status, TO_CHAR(createdAt, 'YY.MM.DD') createdAt, TO_CHAR(updatedAt, 'YY.MM.DD') updatedAt FROM review WHERE productId = #{productId} ORDER BY createdAt
SELECT ri.imageId, ri.orderItemId, ri.files, ri.sortOrder FROM reviewImage ri INNER JOIN review r ON r.orderItemId = ri.orderItemId WHERE r.productId = #{productId} ORDER BY orderItemId, sortOrder

SELECT oi.orderItemId, po.optionId, po.prodSize, po.color FROM productOption po INNER JOIN orderItem oi ON po.optionId = oi.optionId INNER JOIN review r ON oi.orderItemId = r.orderItemId WHERE r.productId = #{productId}
SELECT md.name FROM orderItem oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.orderId = o.orderId INNER JOIN memberDetail md ON o.memberId = md.memberId WHERE oi.orderItemId = #{orderItemId}
